principle: Collections assemble material across owners for reading, recovery, comparison or interpretation. They never transfer canonical ownership merely by inclusion.

collections.title: Corporium Collection
collections.boundary: Corporium assembles sayings, embodiment, affect, persona, recurrence and later formalization. It is a cross-branch interpretive collection, not a new fact owner.

collections.title: Story & Scene Reservoir
collections.boundary: Story assembles documentary and literary material while preserving source depth and uncertainty; narrative sequence does not replace occurrence/source owners.

collections.title: Reader Dossiers
collections.boundary: Reader dossiers summarize owners for accessibility; they do not become canonical owners.

collections.title: Project Guides
collections.boundary: Guides route readers through the House and may be replaced without changing ontology.

collections.title: Indexes & Routing
collections.boundary: Indexes route toward owners, sources and unresolved work; index membership is not itself truth or ownership.
